summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Freedom Day Dividend ETF (MBOX) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund is an actively managed fund that seeks dividend growth by selecting US-listed companies the advisor believes to have the greatest potential to provide rising dividends over time. MBOX was launched on May 5, 2021 and is issued by Freedom Day.

holdings.infoBox: MBOX is an equity ETF with a total of 46 individual holdings. The top holdings are JPMorgan Chase & Co. stock at 3.07%, Dell Technologies at 3.01%, Eaton Corporation at 2.70%, Amgen at 2.62%, and Energy Transfer LP at 2.55%.
